scope: Accept P06-A03 for the explicit RV64 p02-tfr and scaled 2-core VX_tensor_top resource and timing budgets at rtl_verified synthesis-estimate scope, grounded at commit 1cf68ff701c78331f84cb68607764de445689381. Local Beacon (virtexuplusHBM xcu55c-fsvh2892-2L-e) establishes p02-tfr 1-core RV64 (132,962 LUT [10.2% U55C], 89,432 FF [3.4%], 3,904 LUTRAM, 20.0 BRAM [1.0%], 0 URAM, 33 DSP [0.37%], 24 max logic levels) and scaled 2-core VX_tensor_top + 256 KiB L2 + WGMMA + DXA (367,926 LUT [28.2% U55C], 197,220 FF [7.6%], 15,818 LUTRAM, 132.5 BRAM [6.6%], 0 URAM, 11 DSP [0.12%], 25 max logic levels). Gated XLEN=32 Beacon logic_gate passes at 1cf68ff on tensor (267 DSP +0%, 258,820 LUT -1% live vs 260,189 LUT in ci/baselines/synthesis/beacon/tensor.json, 253.4 MHz), core (97 DSP +0%, 143,793 LUT, 285.6 MHz), and tcu (769 DSP +0%, 119,629 LUT live vs 119,887 LUT in ci/baselines/synthesis/beacon/tensor.json, 277.7 MHz). Checked-in ASAP7 Yosys baselines are recorded separately as academic pre-layout ASIC estimates.
configuration: Beacon logic/area estimation targeting AMD/Xilinx Alveo U55C (xcu55c-fsvh2892-2L-e, virtexuplusHBM): (1) local RV64 runs at 1cf68ff for p02-tfr 1-core (VX_core_top) and scaled 2-core VX_tensor_top (USE_DSP=0, STD FPU, VX_CFG_NUM_CORES=4, VX_CFG_SOCKET_SIZE=4, VX_CFG_L2_ENABLE, VX_CFG_L2_SIZE=262144); (2) gated XLEN=32 Beacon logic_gate against ci/baselines/synthesis/beacon/{tensor,core}.json; (3) checked-in ASAP7 Yosys 0.69 + OpenSTA 3.1.0 baselines (xlen=32, tt corner, 800 MHz target) in ci/baselines/synthesis/yosys/{core,tensor}.json.
limitations: All Beacon and Yosys synthesis metrics are rtl_verified pre-implementation estimates and are explicitly NOT physical Vivado FPGA timing, placed-and-routed bitstream utilization, or physical FPGA/silicon measurements.
Local RV64 Beacon U55C estimates evaluate isolated RTL DUTs and exclude the Alveo U55C static/dynamic XRT shell, XDMA host bridge, HBM AXI crossbar, and SLR crossing overhead.
Checked-in ASAP7 Yosys baselines are XLEN=32 academic pre-layout estimates with black-box SRAM heuristics and cannot be cited as foundry sign-off or RV64 silicon PPA.
P01-A03 vendor XRT hw_emu remains blocked and required before P07 can close; P07-P11 remain not_started pending physical Alveo U55C/V80 hardware and human go/no-go approval and funding.
